stories.title: Wales among worst places in UK for cost of a private filling, watchdog says
stories.summary: A private white filling in Wales costs more than a third of what the average person has left to spend in a week after tax, the competition watchdog says. stories.title: Mold Broncoed voters choose new Flintshire councillor today from seven candidates
stories.summary: Polls are open in Mold’s Broncoed ward today, as voters choose a new Flintshire county councillor. Voting runs from 7am until 10pm. The ward has one polling station, at Bethesda Presbyterian Chapel Schoolroom on New Street. Seven candidates are standing for the single seat. stories.title: Senedd rejects bid to pause Wales drinks deposit return scheme
stories.summary: Glass stays in the Welsh scheme after MSs reject calls for a pause and a review, leaving Deeside on the border with England's scheme without glass.

stories.summary: Coleg Cambria was crowned College of the Year at a prestigious national awards ceremony, with one of its leading lecturers recognised among the UK’s best. stories.title: Growing up in Flintshire: what new social mobility data shows
stories.summary: Flintshire is in the lower band of UK council areas for young people’s job opportunities and for the conditions children grow up in, new figures from the Social Mobility Commission show.
